howto.when: 当你要用 GitHub Actions 搭建 CI/CD、自动化开发流程,或需要可复用工作流模板时,它会接管并给出对应的 workflow 配置。

howto.what_en: Claude generates GitHub Actions workflow YAML for you: testing, building and pushing Docker images, deploying to Kubernetes, matrix builds, security scans, and reusable workflows.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automating development workflows, or needing reusable workflow templates.

say_en.text: Write me a GitHub Actions workflow that runs tests on pushes to main
say_en.note: Returns a test workflow with a version matrix

say_en.text: Give me a workflow template that builds a Docker image and pushes it to ghcr.io
say_en.note: Returns login, metadata, build and push steps

say_en.text: Add a Trivy security scan workflow that runs on pull requests
say_en.note: Returns a scan workflow uploading SARIF results
